claims.claim: The maintained diagnostic path covers EXECUTION, VERIFICATION and COMPLETION_GATE. Pre-RUN transport remains operational-only without fabricated RUN identity.
Diagnostics retain exact subject, artifact, digest, origin and reader-authority binding. Tampering, cross-subject replay and changed source authority remain rejected.
Insufficient pytest summaries use the protected original-capture ladder with typed blockers. Capture pins remain on recognized pytest paths; non-pytest failures retain historical summary bytes.
UNKNOWN exception diagnostics retain available safe test identity, exception, repository-relative location and bounded assertion details, with explicit availability for missing or withheld fields.
Structural fields remain separate from filtered technical spans, with typed segment-level release and withholding decisions.
Retained negative cases reject or withhold credentials, private paths, identifiers, parameters, encoded payloads, traversal and injected instructions from portable projections.
The implementation reuses existing protected Runtime readers, canonical Git attribution and public detail contracts. Raw captures remain protected; Brain receives bounded projections.

Finite reader bounds and V1-V4/paging contracts remain intact. Work Context translates snapshot rejection into BrainContextError, preserving its BrainSyncError cause and fail-closed behavior. The 61-case local selection, including both failed nodes, and expanded five-case matrix passed test assertions; both processes exited 1 on execution-profile guards. Canonical verification success is not claimed.
Maintained Brain Sync and Work Context consumers traverse the authenticated reader path through real Git fixtures, without diagnostic scripts or pasted private logs.
Labeled isolated regressions retain RUN-401-002 patch-context, RUN-403-001 malformed-summary and RUN-403-002 UNKNOWN-exception boundaries without fabricating historical private captures.
Retained regression cases cover execution, verification, completion, pre-RUN transport, reader-owned REVIEW/PUBLISH boundaries and future UNKNOWN observations with phase and source witnesses.

Brain remains observational with separate lifecycle authorities and no automatic repair or retry. The three-file repair is committed as a clean direct descendant of the supplied failed candidate; nothing was pushed.
